summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute a 727KB obfuscated payload
details: The package's preinstall hook runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime archive from GitHub (`https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<arch>.zip`), unzips it to a temp directory, marks the binary executable, and invokes it against a bundled `math_init.js` file at the tarball root. `math_init.js` is a 727KB heavily obfuscated blob (string-array rotation via `WV8StW`, hex-encoded `_0x...` identifiers, a large mixed constant array `n7gIxM`, and a decoder `hc1jfK9`) that is not referenced by the package's TypeScript source in `src/` or the compiled `dist/index.js`. The declared package purpose is a small ServiceTitan comm-hub registry (~10KB of TypeScript) with no need for the Bun runtime. Executing an obfuscated bundled payload through a freshly-fetched alternate language runtime at install time bypasses Node-level scanning of the code that actually runs, and the filename `math_init.js` disguises the payload's role. This fires automatically on `npm install` before any user consent.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
